title: RNABioInfo/seq_lm
description: Live QC and differential-expression analysis of ONT transcriptome sequencing data.

input_options.title: Input Options
input_options.description: Input samples and controls for live or one-shot BAM ingestion.

sample_sheet.description: CSV sample sheet describing the BAM directories to analyze.
sample_sheet.help_text: The sheet must contain alias, group, and bam_dir columns. Optional is_live controls live watching. When ICA is active, including order automatically enables ICA time-course analysis and requires a valid elapsed-minute trajectory. is_live accepts true or false case-insensitively; missing or blank values default to true. Samples that are not effectively live must contain at least one BAM at startup.

live_analysis.description: Poll eligible sample directories for new BAM files.
live_analysis.help_text: A sample is polled only when this option and the sample sheet row's is_live value are both true. Disable this option to process every sample once from the BAM files present at startup.

bam_poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between scans of live BAM directories.
bam_poll_interval_seconds.help_text: Polling is used instead of filesystem notifications so Windows-written BAMs below WSL mounts are discovered reliably.

bam_stability_polls.description: Consecutive unchanged observations required before accepting a new BAM.
bam_stability_polls.help_text: A BAM must retain the same size and modification time across this many polls before it is sent to downstream analysis.

timeline_analysis.description: Add descriptive temporal gene-set trajectories using elapsed-minute sample order values.
timeline_analysis.help_text: Requires gene_set_enrichment. Every sample-sheet row must provide a signed integer order value in elapsed minutes; groups represent independent-replicate time points along one trajectory.

reference_options.title: Reference and Gene Set Options
reference_options.description: Reference files used for transcript quantification and gene-set analysis.

reference_genome.description: Reference genome FASTA used by Oarfish for soft-clip rescue.
reference_genome.help_text: Supply this together with reference_annotation to enable transcript quantification, including when differential expression is disabled.

reference_annotation.description: Reference transcript annotation in GTF or GFF3 format used by Oarfish and transcript-biotype QC.
reference_annotation.help_text: Supply this together with reference_genome to enable transcript quantification and the transcript-biotype composition figure. Biotypes use transcript_biotype, transcript_type, or biotype first, then linked gene_biotype, gene_type, or biotype; missing or conflicting annotations are shown as Unknown.

gene_sets.description: Gene Matrix Transposed (GMT) file used for edgeR fry and GSVA gene-set analysis.
gene_sets.help_text: GMT members may match count-table feature identifiers directly or identifiers in the supplied GTF/GFF annotation.

differential_analysis_options.title: Differential Analysis Options
differential_analysis_options.description: Significance thresholds used by edgeR and the differential-analysis report.

differential_expression.description: Run differential-expression analysis from Oarfish transcript quantifications.
differential_expression.help_text: Disable this option to omit differential analysis. Oarfish quantification still runs when both reference genome and annotation inputs are supplied.

gene_set_enrichment.description: Run fry and GSVA gene-set enrichment after differential expression.
gene_set_enrichment.help_text: This option requires differential_expression. The gene_sets input is required only when this option is enabled.

min_read_count.description: Precondition of minimum total assigned reads required for a sample to run a DEA analysis.

min_replicate_sample_count.description: Precondition of minimum number of samples per group that must satisfy the DEA read-count threshold.

de_lfc_cutoff.description: Minimum absolute log2 fold change used by edgeR glmTreat and the report's significance coloring.

de_padj_cutoff.description: Maximum edgeR false-discovery rate used to classify significant results.

run_monitoring_options.title: Run Monitoring Options
run_monitoring_options.description: Run monitoring allows to automatically terminate a run, after sufficient sequencing depth is reached.

monitoring_behavior.description: Action when for a live sample all given contrasts are stable. Options: disabled = No action, log = Log to the console when an acquisition whould be terminated, stop = acquisition is terminated (requires Minknow credentials)

num_stable_batches.description: Number of consecutive stable snapshots required before a sample is eligible to stop.

stability_max_feature_diff_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of filtered features added or dropped between DE snapshots.

stability_max_median_abs_lfc_delta.description: Maximum median absolute change in log2 fold change between DE snapshots.

stability_min_jaccard_similarity.description: Minimum Jaccard similarity of sufficiently large DE-call sets.

stability_min_de_calls_for_fraction_metr.description: DE-call union size at which fractional set-stability metrics replace the stability_max_small_set_call_changes rule.

stability_max_small_set_call_changes.description: Maximum absolute DE-call transitions allowed when the call union is small.

output_options.title: Output Options
output_options.description: Names and locations used for workflow outputs.

ex_name.description: Name used to identify the experiment in workflow metadata and reports.

out_dir.description: Directory in which workflow results and execution reports are published.

minknow_options.title: MinKNOW Connection Options
minknow_options.description: Connection and credential settings used to terminate stable sequencing runs through seq-run-manager.

minknow_host.description: Host name or address of the MinKNOW manager service.

minknow_port.description: Port of the MinKNOW manager service.

minknow_client_certificate.description: PEM-encoded client certificate chain used by seq-run-manager. Required only when monitoring_behavior is terminate.

minknow_client_private_key.description: PEM-encoded client private key used by seq-run-manager. Required only when monitoring_behavior is terminate.

minknow_ca_certificate.description: PEM-encoded MinKNOW root CA certificate used by seq-run-manager. Required only when monitoring_behavior is terminate.

resource_options.title: Resource Options
resource_options.description: Global analysis limits retained for processes that consume them.

min_mapq.description: Minimum read mapping quality available to analysis steps that apply a mapping-quality filter.

advanced_options.title: Advanced Options
advanced_options.description: Telemetry, cloud, validation, and internal workflow settings.

disable_ping.description: Prevent the workflow from sending start and completion telemetry pings.

monochrome_logs.description: Disable ANSI colors in workflow log messages.

validate_params.description: Validate workflow parameters against this schema before analysis starts.

show_hidden_params.description: Include internal parameters in command-line help output.

aws_image_prefix.description: Prefix applied to container image names when running on AWS.

aws_queue.description: AWS Batch queue used by an AWS execution profile.

process_label.description: Default Nextflow process label used by workflow processes.

schema_ignore_params.description: Comma-separated parameters excluded from schema validation.

version.description: Display the workflow version and exit.

imodulon_analysis_options.title: iModulon Analysis Options
imodulon_analysis_options.description: Fixed-matrix projection, control-versus-group differential activity, and automatic time-course visualization when the sample sheet contains order.

ica_analysis.description: Allow iModulon analysis when an ICA matrix is supplied.
ica_analysis.help_text: Set false to skip ICA analysis even when ica_matrix is configured. Without a matrix, ICA is skipped regardless of this toggle.

ica_matrix.description: ICA gene-by-component weights CSV/TSV. Supplying this enables iModulon analysis unless ica_analysis is false.
ica_matrix.help_text: When ICA is enabled, requires both reference inputs. First column: gene IDs; remaining columns: named components. Controls supply the baseline. No activity matrix or metadata sidecar is required.

ica_gene_map.description: Optional explicit annotation-gene to model-gene mapping CSV/TSV.
ica_gene_map.help_text: When ICA is enabled, requires ica_matrix. Columns gene_id and model_gene_id must define a one-to-one map. Automatic matching is not added to an explicit map.

ica_log_base.description: Logarithm base for million-scaled Oarfish gene abundance.

ica_pseudocount.description: Pseudocount added before logging million-scaled gene abundance.

ica_min_gene_coverage.description: Required fraction of model genes represented by annotation targets.
ica_min_gene_coverage.help_text: Default requires all model genes. Lower explicitly to permit partial projection. Coverage does not establish biological validity.

ica_min_read_count.description: Minimum assigned abundance in every sample before analyzing an ICA batch.
ica_min_read_count.help_text: Zero-total samples always defer analysis. This setting is independent of DEA readiness.

ica_padj_cutoff.description: BH-adjusted p-value threshold for Welch differential-activity tests.

docs.intro:
## Introduction

seq_lm performs live or one-shot quality control, transcript quantification, differential-expression analysis, and gene-set enrichment for Oxford Nanopore BAM data.
